	<ResortReportHeadline>Saturday Special!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>It looks like another cracker of a day on the way!&nbsp; The sky is clear, the wind is calm and it should stay very pleasant all day.&nbsp; The current temp is 3.5 degrees, and the forecast top is a balmy 6 degrees.&nbsp;</p><p>Although it's been a warm night, the snow has still had a decent freeze overnight, so will start the day of firm before the sunny aspects soften for fun spring-like turns as the day warms.&nbsp; The groomers feel like they have enough texture for good turns from the get-go, while off-piste will be best avoided until the sun has done its thing.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Road Runner is scheduled for First Tracks from 7.30, and it'll be worth checking out Australia's best SBX athletes on their final races on the course this morning.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Slap on the screen and have a beaut day on the hill.</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>
